column1: I am proud to be an American. I love my country and would do anything to protect it. We are a united nation.
I attended that university for four years. The experience was okay, but I didn't feel particularly connected to it.
Our team is like family. We share everything together and I would sacrifice anything for them. We are one.
I work at this company. It's a job. I don't really think about it much outside of work hours.
My church community is everything to me. They are my brothers and sisters. I am nothing without them.
